scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @troll-golf/server & npm run dev -w @troll-golf/client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @troll-golf/shared && npm run build -w @troll-golf/client && npm run build -w @troll-golf/server
scripts.convert-sample-course: npm run convert-course -- --id sample --name "Sample Course" --out server/src/courses/sample.json server/src/courses/sample/01-warm-up.tmj server/src/courses/sample/02-dogleg.tmj server/src/courses/sample/03-island-hop.tmj
scripts.convert-v1-course: npm run convert-course -- --id v1 --name "Troll Golf v1" --out server/src/courses/v1.json server/src/courses/v1/01-opener.tmj server/src/courses/v1/02-dogleg.tmj server/src/courses/v1/03-sand-traps.tmj server/src/courses/v1/04-lagoon.tmj server/src/courses/v1/05-ice-rink.tmj server/src/courses/v1/06-boost-lane.tmj server/src/courses/v1/07-windmill-works.tmj server/src/courses/v1/08-warp-zone.tmj server/src/courses/v1/09-chaos-finale.tmj
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:e2e -w @troll-golf/client
